llm.summary: The bundled skill generates blog outlines locally with proportionate file access; its optional Windows application is separate and unreviewed.

dimensions.detail: The script reads the selected input and writes outline.md in the selected output directory. Missing tool-scope declarations do not demonstrate excessive authority: inspected code contains no network, credential, shell-execution, or broad-indexing behavior.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The bundled workflow uses Python's standard library without installation or downloads. The optional unsigned Windows application requires a separate user decision. Its [publisher repository](https://github.com/rapidworker1/Multiple-AI-models-Toolkit) advertises a separate multi-model application; that binary was not inspected.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions remain within blog-outline preparation. US-specific output matches the explicitly disclosed US audience, so the scanner's regional-content concern does not establish a security issue.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The bundled code creates output files without background workers, startup hooks, agent-memory changes, or privilege escalation. Existing outline.md output is overwritten.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Keyword-to-Markdown generation fits the stated purpose. The script's expected keywords field differs from the supplied template, and its word target is fixed; these are functional limitations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use a dedicated output directory because outline.md is overwritten, and check the template/input mismatch before relying on results. The optional Windows application is unnecessary for the bundled workflow and needs separate evaluation; its supplied hash alone does not establish safety.
